scope: Generic-j CM ray modulus n=(pi-1), good reduction, rational prime-order r distinct from p; audit of proposed Weber-value collapse
statement: Trivial Artin symbol at p does not collapse the reduced Weber orbit: prime-to-p torsion reduction is injective, so the generic-j orbit of x([u]P) for u mod r up to sign has (r-1)/2 distinct values in Fp. The p=47, r=61, D=-19 control has 30 distinct x-values, contradicting the one-value prediction in IDEA-20260808-5158fa while leaving ray-label extraction unresolved.
